channel.title: How was SCP-5999 Made?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "How was SCP-5999 Made?" - I'm trying to write an SCP of my own, and around half the story takes place using a computer terminal, so I want to make something like that for my own.

item.title: Re: How was SCP-5999 Made?
item.content:encoded:
If you'd like to see how a particular article does something, you can click "+ Options" at the bottom and "Page Source" to view the code.

The code of the terminal layout can be viewed here. It uses an iframe, the contents of which are here and is mostly an HTML block.

Honestly, there isn't really a reason to emulate the article and it seems like more trouble than it's worth. Why are you interested in it?

item.title: How was SCP-5999 Made?
item.content:encoded: I am in the process of writing an SCP, and in the SCP Article, half of the content takes place on a computer terminal. If I had an idea as to how SCP-5999 (This is where I died) was made, then it would make my concept 10x better.
